title: Ben Tre in a day
summary: Eat the breakfast bowl on đường 30 Tháng 4, walk to the museum, then take the boat to Cồn Phụng and Cồn Quy. After dinner, walk Hồ Trúc Giang and the parks.

stops.name: Hu tieu with pate
stops.note: Eat the breakfast bowl with the pork-pâté slice on đường 30 Tháng 4.

stops.name: Ben Tre Museum

approach.note: From đường 30 Tháng 4 to 146 Hùng Vương.

stops.note: Walk the coconut rooms after breakfast, before the boat.

stops.name: Cồn Phụng

approach.note: The river route from the city center is 25 km.

stops.note: Walk the nine-dragon court and the candy kiln on the islet.

stops.name: Cồn Quy

approach.note: Often the same boat as Cồn Phụng.

stops.note: Walk the longan trees, drink honey tea, and bail a ditch for fish.

stops.name: Hồ Trúc Giang

approach.note: From the town bank after dinner.

stops.note: Walk the lake and the three parks, then continue to the night market.

seoTitle: Ben Tre in a day — breakfast, the boat, and the lake
seoDescription: A Ben Tre day: hủ tiếu patê on đường 30 Tháng 4, the museum, a boat to Cồn Phụng and Cồn Quy, and Hồ Trúc Giang after dinner.
